title: Apple is rallying after announcing a monthly subscription service for news (AAPL)
text: Apple shares are rising Tuesday after Bloomberg reported the company is launching a subscription news service.This is part of a broader effort to pivot its focus from devices to services. Apple - Stock - March - Tech - Sector Apple stock got hit in late March, along with the broader tech sector, but remains up for the year. Apple shares are rallying Tuesday, up 1.5% at $178.46, after Bloomberg reported the tech giant is launching a subscription news service. Service - Year - Version - Apple - News The service could launch later this year, and would be an improved version of the current Apple News app, Bloomberg said.
